title: Longer Interset Rest Periods Enhance Muscle Strength and Hypertrophy in Resistance-Trained Men
publication: Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research
key_findings: Resting 3 minutes between sets gave greater squat and bench press 1RM gains than resting 1 minute over 8 weeks.
Anterior thigh thickness grew more with 3-minute rests, with a trend for the triceps (p = 0.06); local muscular endurance improved similarly.
The authors conclude longer rests favoured strength and hypertrophy in this group.
methods: Randomized trial: 3 total-body sessions a week of 7 exercises, 3 sets of 8 to 12RM, with 1-minute or 3-minute rests and other variables held constant, for 8 weeks; 1RM, endurance and ultrasound muscle thickness.
